metadata.title: USA B2B Companies & Corporate Email Database Schema Sample (2026)
metadata.description: Open 50-row 15-column standardized B2B corporate schema sample for United States (USA — All 50 States & Washington, D.C.) classified by 6-Digit NAICS 2022 & 4-Digit US SIC. Full unlocked Excel/CSV production dataset (1,064,565 active US companies, 596,248 verified corporate emails, 982,410 direct phones; $125.00 USD one-time license) documented at https://bigdatalowcost.com/databases/best-usa-email-business-database/ and https://bigdatalowcost.com/free-demo/?country=united-states.
